user.title: Choose the main device
user.description: Choose the device that already has the MAC address, or select manual entry. Registered MAC addresses appear next to each device.

devices.title: Choose devices to link
devices.description: Select all devices to link to {main_name}. You can select multiple devices.

confirm.title: Confirm the shared MAC address
confirm.description: Confirm the MAC address for {main_name}. It will be added to the {device_count} selected device(s).

data.selected_mac_address: MAC address on the main device

error.device_not_found: A selected device is no longer available. Choose the devices again.
error.same_config_entry: Choose devices from different integrations. Devices from the same integration cannot share this MAC address.
error.no_linked_devices: Select at least one device to link.
error.invalid_mac: Select a discovered MAC address or enter a valid MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.connection_conflict: The MAC address is already assigned to another device from one of the selected integrations.

abort.already_configured: This device group and MAC address are already configured.
abort.no_devices: Add devices in another integration before configuring Device Linker.

configure.title: Edit linked devices
configure.description: The main device stays the same. Update the MAC address or change the selected devices. Remove a device from the selection to unlink it; clear the selection to unlink all devices.
